role: four development patients; old-server GTA early preview; canonical agreement pending
centerline_definition: Lee GT skeleton voxel coverage, no distance tolerance; anisotropic physical EDT radius<=1mm versus>1mm; not mm-weighted skeleton length or clinical branch truth
FN_regions_definition: 26-neighbour connected regions of GT-positive/prediction-negative voxels; geometric boxes and EDT-radius proxies only, no distal/proximal/trunk anatomical attribution

surface_definition.surface_definition: foreground boundary voxels removed by one 6-neighbour binary erosion, border_value=0
surface_definition.surface_hd95_mm: max of the two directional surface-distance 95th percentiles
surface_definition.asoca_foreground_hd95_mm: max of the two directional ALL-foreground-voxel distance 95th percentiles
surface_definition.empty_distance_policy: null; cohort distance mean undefined if any required distance is undefined
surface_definition.cldice_role: auxiliary skeleton overlap; ASSD is a boundary error, not connectivity

surface_recalculation: exact Euclidean nearest6-neighbour-surface voxel using KDTree workers=2; reproduced frozen EDT row distances
causal_boundary: Error accounting does not identify the cause in Gaussian loss/classifier/initialization. No significance test/model winner from4 cases.
